title: GribStream Catalog, Coverage, Licence, and Quota Audit
mission: Snapshot the live GribStream catalog/OpenAPI/client metadata, verify every listed model, test geographic coverage, resolve selectors, estimate quota/storage, and document contractual constraints before bulk acquisition.
inputs: HKO/reference coordinates from T05 when ready
steps: Fetch and hash current docs, OpenAPI YAML, model catalog and selector metadata.
Enumerate all current models, including user-listed and newly discovered entries.
For each model, record domain, resolution, cycles, lead range, ensemble members, archive/retention and selector introduction dates.
Run minimal coordinate probes at HKO, inland, coastal and marine points for coverage-probe models.
Resolve exact selector tuples for every P0/P1 semantic variable.
Estimate request rows, bytes, quota and storage by acquisition tier.
Record GribStream ToS constraints and request written clarification for long-term internal commercial retention if needed.
Record upstream attribution/licensing requirements, especially ECMWF CC BY 4.0.
Produce final acquire/probe/exclude decisions; no bulk download yet.
acceptance: Every user-listed model has an explicit disposition
Every core variable has exact selectors or a blocker
Bulk acquisition plan fits quota/storage or is staged
failure: No API key: complete public catalog work and emit authenticated probe command
Unclear retention rights: do not block code, but block bulk commercial ingestion pending written confirmation
